liquidity.summary: Global liquidity is expanding as central banks maintain accommodative policies, supporting risk assets.

fed_policy.summary: Fed is signaling a dovish stance with expectations for rate cuts in the upcoming months which should bolster risk-taking in markets.

inflation.summary: Inflation trends show signs of stabilization, moving towards target levels, reducing pressure on consumers and investors.

risk_appetite.summary: Risk appetite in traditional markets remains elevated, indicated by low volatility and tight credit spreads.

evidence: Bitcoin is approximately 18 months post-halving, historically a bullish period for crypto markets.
Total Value Locked (TVL) in DeFi projects is growing by 30% YoY, indicating healthy adoption and investment in the ecosystem.
cycle.halving_context: 18 months post-halving, historically bullish period; past halvings have led to substantial price increases in the year following.

favor: Large-cap L1s such as Ethereum and Solana due to strong fundamentals and adoption metrics.
